comment: Readings of the operator's free-text notes of the BASS tests, written by a language model. Rules: pipeline/mappings/si/README.md. pipeline/normalize/si_notes.py accepts a value only when its quote is in the note word for word. A key is the as-run test number and the test number of the As Run Test Matrix; a row or a field that is missing means the note does not say.
method: read in a Claude Code session, following pipeline/mappings/si/README.md
